# KEN AROK: TAKDIR DARI TUMAPEL

<!-- scene-id: 78e6685e-65f8-477e-a0cb-0b90e3713ec5 -->
### EXT. HUTAN TUMAPEL - DAY

Angin kering menggerakkan dedaunan jati. Bau tanah terbakar matahari menyengat udara.

KEN AROK (20-an), bertubuh tegap, berambut ikal kusut terikat kain perca, berlari kencang menerobos semak berduri. Di tangannya tergenggam sekantung beras hasil jarahan.

Tiga orang PRAJURIT TUMAPEL mengejarnya dengan tombak terhunus.

Ken Arok melompat melewati batang pohon tumbang. Kakinya menjejak tanah dengan cekatan. Dia membalikkan badan, menyeringai menantang.

**KEN AROK**

Hanya segitu kecepatan prajurit istana? Kura-kura di rawa pun masih bisa mendahului kalian!

Prajurit pertama menyerang dengan tombak. Ken Arok berkelit santai, menangkap tangkai tombak, lalu menyikut rahang lawannya hingga terjerembap.

Dua prajurit lain ragu-ragu untuk maju.

Seorang pertapa tua berpakaian putih lusuh berjalan santai keluar dari balik pepohonan. Dialah DANG HYANG LOHGAWE (60-an), tatapannya tajam menembus batin.

Lohgawe mengangkat tangan kanannya perlahan.

**DANG HYANG LOHGAWE**

Hentikan amarah kalian. Darah anak muda ini bukan untuk tumpah di tanah berlumpur ini.

Para prajurit menghentikan langkah, tertegun oleh aura wibawa Lohgawe.

**PRAJURIT SATU**

Bapa Brahmana... pemuda itu perampok licik!

**DANG HYANG LOHGAWE**

Dia mencuri untuk bertahan hidup, bukan untuk meruntuhkan dharma. Tinggalkan dia bersamaku.

Para prajurit saling pandang, lalu berbalik mundur perlahan dan menghilang di antara pepohonan.

Ken Arok menatap Lohgawe dengan curiga, mengusap debu di dagunya.

**KEN AROK**

Aku tidak meminta belas kasihan seorang pertapa.

**DANG HYANG LOHGAWE**

Aku tidak menaruh kasihan, Ken Arok. Aku menaruh ramalan. Dewa Wisnu tidak mengirimmu ke dunia fana hanya untuk menjadi pencuri rendahan.

Ken Arok terpaku.

##### CUT TO:

<!-- scene-id: ee03d9f1-bb81-4ff8-88c7-6bcdb43fcd7f -->
### INT. PENDOPO KEDIAMAN AKUWU TUMAPEL - DAY

Suasana hening dan mencekam. Lantai batu berhiaskan ukiran kuno yang anggun.

TUNGGUL AMETUNG (40-an), penguasa zalim Tumapel dengan kumis melintang dan mata culas, duduk di singgasananya memegang cawan arak.

Di sudut ruangan, KEN DEDES (20-an), berparas jelita bak titisan bidadari, duduk terpaku dengan pandangan hampa. Gaun sutra melilit tubuhnya yang ramping.

Lohgawe melangkah masuk ke tengah pendopo, menunduk memberi sembah. Ken Arok berjalan dua langkah di belakangnya dengan pakaian yang lebih rapi.

**DANG HYANG LOHGAWE**

Sembah hamba, Akuwu Tunggul Ametung. Hamba membawa pemuda berbakat yang dapat menjaga keselamatan balairung istana.

Tunggul Ametung melirik Ken Arok dari atas sampai bawah, mendengus meremehkan.

**TUNGGUL AMETUNG**

Anak jalanan? Apa kelebihannya selain bau keringat dan lumpur?

**DANG HYANG LOHGAWE**

Dia memiliki kesetiaan dan ketangkasan sepuluh prajurit terbaikmu.

Ken Dedes bangkit perlahan dari duduknya untuk menyajikan tuak ke meja suaminya. Saat langkahnya melintasi undakan, semilir angin menyingkap kain jarik di kakinya sekejap mata.

Cahaya berpendar keemasan terpancar dari betis Ken Dedes.

Mata Ken Arok membelalak. Dadanya bergemuruh hebat seolah dihantam halilintar.

Tunggul Ametung meneguk tuak tanpa menyadari apapun.

**TUNGGUL AMETUNG**

Baiklah. Biarkan dia bertugas menjaga gerbang dalam malam ini. Jangan sampai ada tikus menyelinap.

Ken Arok menundukkan kepala, namun matanya tetap tertuju pada langkah anggun Ken Dedes.

##### CUT TO:

<!-- scene-id: b20baac9-1535-4193-8f89-b0b2b65a482e -->
### EXT. BENGKEL EMPU GANDRING - NIGHT

Hujan deras mengguyur atap pondok jerami. Di dalam, kilatan api merah menyala-nyala dari tungku penempaan.

EMPU GANDRING (50-an), bertelanjang dada penuh jelaga, menghantam sebilah keris yang masih membara di atas landasan besi.

DENTANG! DENTANG!

Pintu bengkel didobrak. Ken Arok berdiri di ambang pintu, basah kuyup oleh hujan malam.

**KEN AROK**

Gandring! Di mana pusakaku?

Empu Gandring tidak menoleh, terus memukulkan palu ke bilah besi.

**EMPU GANDRING**

Keris ini belum tuntas, anak muda. Butuh lima purnama lagi agar hawa pusaka ini sempurna dan tidak menuntut kutukan.

Ken Arok melangkah cepat, merebut bilah keris yang setengah jadi itu langsung dari jepitan tang besi. Logam itu berdesis, mengeluarkan hawa dingin yang mistis.

**KEN AROK**

Aku tak punya waktu lima purnama. Takdirku memanggil malam ini.

**EMPU GANDRING**

_(panik)_

Jangan lancang! Keris itu haus darah yang belum disucikan mantra! Kembalikan!

Empu Gandring mencoba merebutnya kembali.

Ken Arok kalap. Dengan gerakan kilat, dia menghujamkan ujung runcing keris itu ke dada sang empu penempa.

Empu Gandring terbatuk, darah kental merembes membasahi dadanya. Dia menatap Ken Arok dengan tatapan menusuk.

**EMPU GANDRING**

_(terengah-engah)_

Terkutuk kau, Arok... Keris ini... akan meminta nyawamu... dan tujuh turunan dari darahmu... mati oleh keris yang sama!

Empu Gandring roboh menghantam abu perapian.

Ken Arok memandangi keris di tangannya yang berlumuran darah. Kilatan petir di luar menerangi seringai dingin di wajahnya.

**KEN AROK**

Kutukan orang sekarat tidak akan menghentikan langkah seorang raja.

Ken Arok berbalik dan melangkah menerobos badai malam.

assets.name: Dang Hyang Lohgawe
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A South East Asian Brahmin ascetic in his early 60s with a lean, sinewy build. He has sun-weathered tan skin, prominent cheekbones, and sharp, piercing dark brown eyes beneath thick, graying eyebrows. His hair is long and iron-gray, tied into a high, traditional topknot, complemented by a flowing, untrimmed white beard that reaches his collarbone.
assets.clothingAccessories: Draped in a tattered, off-white unbleached cotton robe wrapped across the left shoulder in traditional Brahmin style, paired with a matching loose dhoti-style wrap reaching his calves. Around his neck hangs a long rosary of carved dark brown rudraksha beads, and his feet are bare with worn leather thong sandals tied at the ankles.
assets.backstory: A revered Hindu sage from India who traveled across Java following divine visions, seeking the destined supreme ruler of the archipelago. He sees Ken Arok not as a common thief, but as an avatar of Vishnu bound for royal destiny.

assets.name: Empu Gandring
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A Javanese master blacksmith in his mid-50s with a heavily muscled, broad-shouldered physique forged by decades of metalwork. His dark bronze skin is slick with sweat and streaked with black soot, showcasing calloused hands with thick, blunt fingers. He has short, coarse black-and-silver peppered hair, a flat nose, wide jaw, and a bristly salt-and-pepper mustache and goatee.
assets.clothingAccessories: Bare-chested with charcoal dust clinging to his torso, he wears a thick, oil-stained brown buffalo-leather apron secured with iron buckles over dark indigo rolled-up knee-length breeches. Thick woven cord protects his forearms, while his feet are shielded by hardened, ash-covered leather work boots.
assets.backstory: A legendary artisan renowned for infusing supernatural power and spiritual incantations into the blades he forges. His refusal to yield an incomplete, spiritually volatile weapon ultimately leads to his tragic confrontation with Ken Arok.

assets.name: Ken Arok
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A Javanese man in his mid-20s possessing a rugged, athletic, and fiercely agile physique. He has warm golden-brown skin, an angular jawline, a wide grin, and deep, amber-brown predatory eyes. His unruly, wavy jet-black hair falls past his shoulders in messy strands, framed by a light, scruffy stubble along his sharp chin.
assets.clothingAccessories: Wears a faded crimson cloth headband securing his messy curls, an open earthy-brown sleeveless vest over a bare chest, and an indigo-patterned batik sarong hitched up above his knees and tied with a coarse hemp rope belt. His feet are bare and mud-splattered, complemented by braided cord wristbands on both forearms.
assets.backstory: Raised as an orphaned bandit and street thief in the jungles of Tumapel, he survives purely by his cunning, physical prowess, and raw ambition. After crossing paths with Lohgawe and catching a glimpse of Ken Dedes, his aspirations shift violently toward supreme political power.

assets.name: Ken Dedes
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A striking Javanese woman in her early 20s with an ethereal, luminous complexion and a slender, regal frame. She has large, almond-shaped obsidian eyes fringed with thick dark lashes, soft rose-toned lips, and a high-bridged nose. Her lustrous, blue-black hair is arranged into an elaborate royal updo adorned with fresh white jasmine buds.
assets.clothingAccessories: Draped in an exquisite golden-yellow and emerald green silk kemben wrapped tightly around her torso, accented by an intricately patterned dark brown batik jarik skirt that reveals glowing, radiant golden skin beneath the hem. She wears engraved bronze armlets shaped like serpents, layered gold drop earrings, and ornate brass anklets.
assets.backstory: The daughter of a respected Buddhist monk, she was abducted by Akuwu Tunggul Ametung to serve as his trophy consort. Prophecy names her the mother of kings, marked by the divine, radiant glow that emanates from her body.

assets.name: Prajurit Satu
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A Javanese soldier in his early 30s with a stout, heavily built frame and thick neck. He features a round, sunburnt face, dark brown narrow eyes, a crooked nose from a healed break, and a thin, downward-turned black mustache. His coarse black hair is cut short and uneven beneath his military headpiece.
assets.clothingAccessories: Clad in a sleeveless dark brown padded leather tunic over a short dark red cotton loincloth wrap tied at the waist with a thick cord. He wears a simple conical lacquered leather cap, reinforced split-leather forearm guards, and heavy woven fiber sandals on his dirt-caked feet.
assets.backstory: A seasoned Tumapel palace guard captain accustomed to brutally crushing peasant rebellions and highway bandits. Despite his aggressive temperament, he holds deep reverence and superstitious dread toward powerful holy ascetics like Lohgawe.

assets.name: Prajurit Tumapel
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A lean, athletic Javanese soldier in his late 20s with a wiry, combat-trained build. He has dark copper skin, prominent brow ridges over suspicious black eyes, and a taut jawline. His straight black hair is pulled back into a small, tight bun at the crown of his head.
assets.clothingAccessories: Outfitted in a sleeveless hardened leather cuirass dyed deep russet brown over an unbleached coarse cotton sash, matched with a dark gray knee-length sarong hitched for running. His wrists are bound with defensive rawhide bracers, and he wears strapped leather field sandals on his feet.
assets.backstory: One of Akuwu Tunggul Ametung's ruthless territorial enforcers charged with policing the outskirts of the kingdom. Trained to show no mercy to lower-class outlaws, he relies heavily on numbers and polearms to overpower foes.

assets.name: Tunggul Ametung
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A bulky, imposing Javanese ruler in his mid-40s with a heavy midsection and broad, fleshy shoulders. His face is weathered and stern, featuring a thick, waxed horizontal handlebar mustache, deep laugh lines around a cruel mouth, and heavy-lidded, bloodshot dark eyes beneath prominent, furrowed brows. His dark hair is slicked back into an ornate, jeweled chignon.
assets.clothingAccessories: Dressed in a lavish deep-purple silk kain intricately woven with shimmering golden thread, secured at the waist with an ornate gold belt featuring a dragon buckle. He wears heavy multi-tiered gold necklaces, wide beaten-gold arm cuffs on both biceps, large gemstone earplugs, and soft velvet slippers.
assets.backstory: The tyrannical Akuwu of Tumapel who seized control of the region through brute force and cunning subjugation. Indulging in wine, concubines, and unchecked power, he rules with an iron fist while remaining oblivious to the prophetic threats gathering inside his own court.

assets.name: Bengkel Empu Gandring
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A compact 15-foot by 20-foot open-sided blacksmith workshop constructed from rough-hewn timber pillars beneath a steeply pitched thatched straw roof. Inside, a clay-and-stone forge glows with burning coals, flanked by a massive iron anvil resting on a weathered tree stump, quench barrels of murky water, and racks of hand-forged tools hung along bamboo slat walls. The floor is hard-packed earth dusted with dark gray charcoal ash, illuminated by the fiery red glow of the furnace and sharp flashes of lightning from the storm outside.

assets.name: Hutan Tumapel
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A sprawling tropical teak forest marked by towering dry-bark trees, tangled thorny undergrowth, and moss-covered fallen logs spanning across narrow dirt trails. The ground is dry, sun-baked earth mixed with patches of damp mud, surrounded by dense foliage and scattered limestone boulders. Harsh, glaring midday sunlight filters through the canopy in sharp diagonal beams, casting high-contrast shadows across the natural woodland clearings.

assets.name: Pendopo Kediaman Akuwu Tumapel
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A grand 40-foot by 50-foot open-air Javanese pavilion featuring polished gray andesite stone floors etched with intricate relief carvings, supported by massive dark-stained teak pillars. A carved wooden throne draped in deep red textiles sits elevated on a stone dais, complemented by low brass offering tables and woven ceremonial mats positioned at the perimeter. The hall is lit by soft natural daylight pouring between open columned perimeter walls, accented by flickering bronze oil braziers casting a warm golden glow over the seating areas.

assets.name: Cawan Arak
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A heavy, hand-hammered bronze drinking goblet marked by deep verdigris patina along its flared pedestal base. The wide, shallow rim is lined with ornate relief carvings of twisting lotus vines, slightly stained by dried, dark amber liquor residue.

assets.name: Keris
assets.physicalCharacteristics: An unfinished, wavy-bladed dagger forged from dark folded meteoric iron, showing faint damascene pamor patterns beneath a rough, soot-charred texture and a freshly bloodstained tip. The tang ends in a bare, exposed metal rod entirely lacking an ornate wooden hilt or protective sheath.

assets.name: Palu
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A heavy blacksmithing hammer featuring an asymmetrical, pitted iron head with flattened, impact-scuffed striking faces darkened by soot and heat scale. The head is securely wedged onto a thick, ash wood handle that is hand-polished and deeply grease-stained from long use.

assets.name: Sekantung Beras
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A coarse, loosely woven brown jute sack bound tightly around the bunched neck with frayed hemp twine, showing patchy dirt smears and a few loose white rice grains poking through strained seam punctures. The lower half is visibly plump and molded by the shifting bulk of small, raw grain within.

assets.name: Tang Besi
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A set of long-reach blacksmith tongs made of heavy hand-forged wrought iron with a rough, soot-covered matte black surface. The tool features flat-jawed gripping ends connected by an oversized pivot rivet to long, rounded lever handles that taper smoothly toward their looped ends.

assets.name: Tombak
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A traditional infantry spear consisting of an eight-foot shaft made from polished dark teak wood, capped with an elongated leaf-shaped bronze spearhead showing sharpened, glinting bevels and oxidized green lowlights. A thick collar of braided brass wire and a short tuft of dyed red horsehair bind the socket tightly to the wood beneath the point.

frames.title: Chased Through Dense Woods
frames.visualDescription: Ken Arok sprints urgently through the tangled brush of Hutan Tumapel, holding a rough fabric Sekantung Beras tightly against his chest. Dust kicks up beneath his bare feet as dry teak leaves rustle around him. In the distant background, three Prajurit Tumapel in armor give chase with their Tombak raised aggressively. Golden sunlight cuts through the canopy, highlighting Ken Arok's disheveled hair and determined expression.
frames.audioDescription: Heavy panting and the sharp snapping of twigs underfoot dominate the foreground. The distant shouting of soldiers and metallic rattling of armor echo through the trees. A tense, rhythmic tribal percussion builds underneath.
frames.motionDescription: The camera tracks rapidly backward ahead of Ken Arok, keeping him centered as the foliage whips past the frame edges.

frames.title: Arok Taunts the Pursuers
frames.visualDescription: Ken Arok leaps smoothly onto a moss-covered fallen log and pivots back to face his pursuers with an arrogant grin. One hand grips the Sekantung Beras while his other arm gestures dismissively toward the approaching soldiers. The Prajurit Tumapel fan out in the clearing below, panting heavily with their weapons leveled.
frames.audioDescription: Ken Arok delivers his mocking line with sharp arrogance. The soldiers respond with guttural grunts and agitated shouts, accompanied by the rustle of disturbed undergrowth.
frames.motionDescription: A low-angle medium shot pans slightly up as Ken Arok lands on the log, emphasizing his agile stance and height advantage.

frames.title: Disarming the Royal Guard
frames.visualDescription: Prajurit Satu lunges forward thrusting his Tombak directly toward Ken Arok. Ken Arok effortlessly pivots his body aside, catching the wooden shaft with one hand while driving a brutal elbow strike directly into Prajurit Satu's jaw. The soldier stumbles backward into the dirt, stunned, as the other Prajurit Tumapel freeze in shock.
frames.audioDescription: A sharp whoosh of the spear tip slicing empty air is followed immediately by the blunt, fleshy impact of the elbow strike. Prajurit Satu lets out a painful cry as he hits the ground.
frames.motionDescription: A dynamic handheld camera pushes in tightly on the impact, whipping slightly to follow the momentum of the falling guard.

frames.title: Brahmana Halts the Conflict
frames.visualDescription: Dang Hyang Lohgawe emerges calmly from behind a massive ancient banyan tree, clad in weathered white robes that glow under the dappled sunlight. His right hand is raised in a serene, commanding gesture of peace. Prajurit Satu and the remaining Prajurit Tumapel lower their weapons slightly, frozen in awe and reverence before the holy man.
frames.audioDescription: Dang Hyang Lohgawe speaks with a resonant, serene authority that echoes through the forest. The ambient wind gently hushes, silencing the clamor of the soldiers.
frames.motionDescription: A slow, stately tilt up from the hem of Lohgawe's robes reveals his serene face and raised hand, establishing his dominant spiritual presence.

frames.title: Suspicious Rebel Stares Back
frames.visualDescription: Ken Arok wipes a streak of dirt and sweat from his jaw with the back of his hand, narrowing his eyes warily at the sage. Behind him, the figures of Prajurit Satu and the other soldiers retreat cautiously into the shadowed thicket. Ken Arok keeps a defensive grip on the Sekantung Beras slung beside him.
frames.audioDescription: Ken Arok speaks with gruff defiance and skepticism. The soft footsteps of retreating soldiers fade into the distance, accompanied by the ambient chirping of forest birds.
frames.motionDescription: A medium close-up steadily pushes in toward Ken Arok's guarded face as he speaks, capturing the shift from adrenaline to wariness.

frames.title: A Prophecy Unveiled
frames.visualDescription: Dang Hyang Lohgawe stands close to Ken Arok, his piercing eyes boring straight into the young rebel's soul. Ken Arok stands completely paralyzed, his defiant posture softening into sheer disbelief. Soft, warm rays of sunlight illuminate the space between the two men amidst the ancient canopy of Hutan Tumapel.
frames.audioDescription: Dang Hyang Lohgawe speaks of divine destiny with quiet, thunderous gravity. A low, ethereal drone swells in the score, cutting out all other forest noise as Ken Arok is struck by the revelation.
frames.motionDescription: A slow, tense two-shot arc gently rotates around the two men, ending framed over Lohgawe's shoulder onto Ken Arok's stunned reaction.

frames.sceneTitle: Int. Pendopo Kediaman Akuwu Tumapel - Day
frames.title: Tunggul Ametung Enthroned
frames.visualDescription: Tunggul Ametung sits imperiously on his ornate wooden throne inside the cavernous Pendopo Kediaman Akuwu Tumapel. In his right hand, he loosely holds a Cawan Arak filled with spiced wine, his cunning gaze surveying the grand hall. To the far corner, Ken Dedes sits motionless in her flowing silk gown, staring into empty space with a sorrowful expression. Intricate stone carvings and towering wooden pillars frame the tense, opulent interior.
frames.audioDescription: Distant resonant gamelan hums in a low, ominous drone beneath the oppressive silence. A soft clink sounds as Tunggul Ametung twirls his wine cup against the armrest.
frames.motionDescription: Slow push-in toward Tunggul Ametung on his throne. The camera begins wide, revealing Ken Dedes in the background before centering firmly on the Akuwu.

frames.sceneTitle: Int. Pendopo Kediaman Akuwu Tumapel - Day
frames.title: Lohgawe Presents Ken Arok
frames.visualDescription: Dang Hyang Lohgawe steps forward onto the polished stone floor of the pendopo, bowing with hands raised in a respectful sembah. Two paces behind him stands Ken Arok, dressed in clean rustic garments, his posture tense yet upright. Tunggul Ametung looms in the foreground, looking down disdainfully from his elevated dais.
frames.audioDescription: The rustle of cotton fabric and the crisp echo of footsteps across stone tile. Dang Hyang Lohgawe speaks in a calm, measured voice: 'Sembah hamba, Akuwu Tunggul Ametung. Hamba membawa pemuda berbakat yang dapat menjaga keselamatan balairung istana.'
frames.motionDescription: Tracking shot moving sideways as Dang Hyang Lohgawe advances, coming to rest at a medium two-shot of Lohgawe and Ken Arok bowing before the throne.

frames.sceneTitle: Int. Pendopo Kediaman Akuwu Tumapel - Day
frames.title: A Mocking Reception
frames.visualDescription: Close-up of Tunggul Ametung's sneering face as he scans Ken Arok from head to toe with utter contempt. His thick mustache twitches with a scoff as he raises his Cawan Arak toward his lips. In the soft background, Dang Hyang Lohgawe maintains his dignified composure amidst the Akuwu's blatant arrogance.
frames.audioDescription: Tunggul Ametung lets out a harsh, mocking snort followed by his gruff voice: 'Anak jalanan? Apa kelebihannya selain bau keringat dan lumpur?' Dang Hyang Lohgawe calmly replies off-screen.
frames.motionDescription: A slight low-angle tilt upward to emphasize Tunggul Ametung's domineering presence, with subtle handheld micro-movements to enhance the tension.

frames.sceneTitle: Int. Pendopo Kediaman Akuwu Tumapel - Day
frames.title: The Golden Aura
frames.visualDescription: Ken Dedes rises gracefully and ascends the low stone steps to serve palm wine to the Akuwu's table. A sudden gentle gust sweeps across the floor, lifting the hem of her patterned jarik cloth. An otherworldly, dazzling golden luminescence radiates brightly from her exposed calf, casting a warm supernatural glow across the stone steps.
frames.audioDescription: A sudden ethereal chime layered with a resonant, sub-bass pulse rises above the silence. The gentle rustle of silk fabric fluttering in an inexplicable wind.
frames.motionDescription: A low-angle tracking shot following Ken Dedes's bare foot stepping upward, suddenly decelerating into slow-motion as the cloth parts to reveal the radiant golden glow.

frames.sceneTitle: Int. Pendopo Kediaman Akuwu Tumapel - Day
frames.title: Arok Struck by Lightning
frames.visualDescription: Tight extreme close-up on Ken Arok's wide, astonished eyes, reflecting the golden radiance glowing in front of him. His breath catches in his throat, jaw clenched tight as a tempest of sudden epiphany and burning ambition hits his face. The opulent background of the pendopo dissolves into a shallow, dreamlike blur.
frames.audioDescription: A heavy, muffled heartbeat thumps loudly in the soundscape, completely drowning out the ambient room tone. A subtle whoosh echoes, mirroring the thunderous shock striking Ken Arok's chest.
frames.motionDescription: Rapid snap zoom punch-in directly into Ken Arok's pupils, freezing momentarily before settling with subtle, trembling handheld framing.

frames.sceneTitle: Int. Pendopo Kediaman Akuwu Tumapel - Day
frames.title: Assignment at Gate
frames.visualDescription: Tunggul Ametung casually drinks deep from his Cawan Arak, completely oblivious to the mystical phenomenon. Ken Dedes steps past behind the throne, casting her sorrowful eyes downward. Ken Arok dutifully bows his head to acknowledge the Akuwu's orders, yet his intense gaze remains locked onto the path where Ken Dedes just walked.
frames.audioDescription: The heavy swallow of wine and a dry thud as the cup meets the table. Tunggul Ametung dismissively orders: 'Baiklah. Biarkan dia bertugas menjaga gerbang dalam malam ini. Jangan sampai ada tikus menyelinap.'
frames.motionDescription: Slow pull-back shot rising higher, re-establishing the wide composition of the hall as Ken Arok remains bowed while Ken Dedes recedes into the shadows.

frames.title: Sparks in the Dark
frames.visualDescription: Inside the dimly lit Bengkel Empu Gandring, heavy rain lashes against the bamboo walls while red fire flickers intensely from the forge. An aged Empu Gandring, shirtless and covered in soot and sweat, hammers rhythmically onto a glowing hot Keris held over an iron anvil with Tang Besi. Glowing embers and sparks scatter across the workshop with every forceful strike of his Palu.
frames.audioDescription: Deafening sound of torrential rain and distant thunderclaps outside. The loud, metallic ring of hammer strikes against glowing steel echoes rhythmically, accompanied by the crackle of burning coals.
frames.motionDescription: Medium close-up slowly tracking inward toward Empu Gandring's focused, sweat-streaked face and the glowing weapon on the anvil.

frames.title: Intrusion in the Storm
frames.visualDescription: The wooden door swings violently open into Bengkel Empu Gandring, revealing Ken Arok standing framed in the threshold. He is soaking wet from the pouring rain, his dark hair plastered to his forehead and his intense eyes glowing with restless ambition. Water drips steadily from his garments as cold wind and mist surge into the warm, smoky room.
frames.audioDescription: A loud wood splintering crash as the door is kicked open, letting in a sudden crescendo of wind, rain, and a roaring thunderclap. Ken Arok's sharp, demanding voice cuts through the storm.
frames.motionDescription: Low-angle wide shot holding steady on the doorway before executing a rapid push-in to Ken Arok's menacing silhouette.

frames.title: Seizing the Cursed Blade
frames.visualDescription: Ken Arok lunges forward to wrench the unfinished Keris directly away from Empu Gandring's iron tongs. The blade gives off a strange supernatural hiss, shedding faint wisps of steam and eerie cool light that contrast against the fiery glow of the forge. Empu Gandring drops his Palu in shock, his face contorting into sudden panic as he reaches out in desperation.
frames.audioDescription: A sharp metallic scrape followed by an ominous mystical hiss from the cooling steel. Empu Gandring gasps in dread as Ken Arok speaks with venomous impatience.
frames.motionDescription: Close-up over Empu Gandring's shoulder, quickly panning across to focus on Ken Arok's hand clutching the hilt of the raw blade.

frames.title: The Fatal Thrust
frames.visualDescription: In a brutal, frenzied motion inside Bengkel Empu Gandring, Ken Arok drives the sharp tip of the unfinished Keris deep into Empu Gandring's chest. Crimson blood instantly bubbles forth, staining the old smith's bare torso as his hands claw weakly at Ken Arok's arms. The fiery furnace light casts harsh, dramatic shadows across Ken Arok's merciless expression.
frames.audioDescription: A sickening wet puncture sound punctuated by a choked, agonizing gasp from Empu Gandring. The furnace fire roars violently in sync with a rumbling bass boom.
frames.motionDescription: Dynamic side-profile medium shot with a sudden camera jolt upon the strike, freezing briefly on the violent impact.

frames.title: Dying Breath of Gandring
frames.visualDescription: Empu Gandring collapses backward against the dusty floor of Bengkel Empu Gandring, his back resting near the smoldering ash pit. Dark blood trickles from his lips and across his chest as he raises a trembling, soot-stained finger toward his murderer. His eyes burn with supernatural rage and finality as he pronounces the seven-generation curse.
frames.audioDescription: A wheezing, wet death rattle as Empu Gandring rasps his final curse. A high-pitched eerie ringing drone underscores his prophecy, fading only slightly under the storm outside.
frames.motionDescription: High-angle shot tilting down toward Empu Gandring's dying body, gently pushing closer to capture his vengeful gaze.

frames.title: Into the Dark Tempest
frames.visualDescription: Ken Arok inspects the bloodied Keris held firmly in his grasp, a cold, arrogant smirk spreading across his face as bright lightning flashes through the doorway. Behind him, the lifeless body of Empu Gandring lies still in the ash. Ken Arok turns his back on the carnage and strides purposefully out into the torrential night rain, engulfed by storm winds.
frames.audioDescription: A thunderous lightning strike cracking directly overhead. Ken Arok's chillingly confident parting words dissolve into the howling tempest and heavy sheets of rain.
frames.motionDescription: Slow tracking shot from behind Ken Arok, moving through the doorway as he disappears into the stormy darkness outside Bengkel Empu Gandring.

frames.title: Tension in Tumapel
frames.visualDescription: Ken Arok stands quietly near the carved pillars of Pendopo Kediaman Akuwu Tumapel, watching Tunggul Ametung seated on his raised dais. Tunggul Ametung gestures dismissively while clutching a Cawan Arak in his hand. The warm afternoon sun casts deep, angled shadows across the stone floor between the two men. Ken Arok remains tense, his hands clasped firmly in front of him.
frames.audioDescription: The faint clink of the drinking vessel setting down blends with distant courtyard chatter. A low, rhythmic drone hums softly beneath the ambient palace wind.
frames.motionDescription: The camera begins in a wide shot and slowly pushes in toward Ken Arok's watchful posture. A subtle counter-pan maintains Tunggul Ametung in the edge of the frame.

frames.title: A Silent Confrontation
frames.visualDescription: A tight medium close-up of Ken Arok reveals his intense, calculating gaze fixed on his ruler. In the soft-focus background, Tunggul Ametung leans forward aggressively, speaking sharp words across the chamber. Light catches the sweat on Ken Arok's brow as he absorbs the command without shifting an inch.
frames.audioDescription: The spoken dialogue echoes sharply against the stone architecture, muffled slightly by Ken Arok's internalized focus. A taut string instrument swells with rising dissonance.
frames.motionDescription: The camera holds steady on Ken Arok with minimal handheld breathing. It drifts slightly to the right to accentuate his locked jaw.

frames.title: Descent Into Darkness
frames.visualDescription: An over-the-shoulder shot framing Ken Arok's silhouette looking toward Tunggul Ametung as the ruler turns away in disdain. The chamber light rapidly dims as shadows stretch across the wooden pavilion beams. The scene steadily dissolves into complete, impenetrable blackness.
frames.audioDescription: A heavy, resonant gong tolls once and reverberates into silence. The ambient room tone abruptly decays into a dead, ominous hush.
frames.motionDescription: The camera slowly pulls backward away from the figures. As it retreats, the exposure drops steadily until the screen fades to black.
